summary_en: This phase 2 study compares encorafenib, binimetinib and nivolumab with ipilimumab and nivolumab in BRAF V600 mutant melanoma that has spread to the brain. Encorafenib and binimetinib are taken by mouth, and nivolumab is given by IV on day 1 of each cycle. In the other arm, ipilimumab is given by IV on day 1 of cycles 1 to 4, with cycles repeating every 21 days for 4 cycles and then every 28 days, while disease does not progress or toxicity is not unacceptable.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara encorafenib, binimetinib y nivolumab con ipilimumab y nivolumab en melanoma con mutación BRAF V600 que se ha diseminado al cerebro. Encorafenib y binimetinib se toman por vía oral, y nivolumab se administra por vía intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo. En el otro brazo, ipilimumab se administra por vía intravenosa el día 1 de los ciclos 1 a 4, y los ciclos se repiten cada 21 días durante 4 ciclos y luego cada 28 días, mientras la enfermedad no progrese ni la toxicidad sea inaceptable. El estudio busca saber qué enfoque es más eficaz para reducir y controlar las metástasis cerebrales.
who_for: Melanoma with BRAF V600 mutation confirmed by a CLIA-certified laboratory.
Melanoma that has spread to the brain, with at least one brain lesion 0.5 cm or larger.
Brain lesion not irradiated, or progressed after prior radiation, per treating physician.
Zubrod performance status of 2 or less.
not_for: Uveal melanoma as the primary site.
Prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease; neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy is allowed.
Radiation therapy within 7 days before randomization.
Pregnant or nursing, or not willing to use effective contraception; hormonal contraceptives are not allowed.
Serious active infection needing systemic therapy, or certain autoimmune disease treated with biologics in the past 6 months.
